inv.desc_en:
Transfer: €160,000
70m² premises with a tobacco license distributed on a single floor, with a 1-meter glazed façade, at street level, with a lot of foot traffic as it is located on one of the main streets of the Gracia neighborhood.
There are 14 years left of the business transfer and it has 8 points of sale.
The premises have 25m² for the sales area, as well as 1 toilet, a room with a small kitchen and a storeroom.
With the possibility of transferring with available stock, for an additional amount.
Conditioned to continue with the activity.

Rent: €1,200
Contract: 4 years
Incasol deposit: 2 months
Additional guarantee: to be assessed.
